contribution_types.scope: CVPR 2025 publishes no official contribution-type taxonomy in the retrieved CFP, author guidelines or reviewer guidelines.
contribution_types.quote: Papers in the main technical program must describe high-quality, original research.

review_criteria.name: Technical soundness
review_criteria.official_explanation: Accepted papers should be technically sound and contribute to the field.
review_criteria.quote: Each paper that is accepted should be technically sound and make a contribution to the field.

review_criteria.name: Novelty and brave concepts
review_criteria.official_explanation: Reviewers are told to embrace novel concepts even without testing on many datasets.
review_criteria.quote: We recommend that you embrace novel, brave concepts, even if they have not been tested on many datasets.

review_criteria.name: Novelty and potential impact
review_criteria.official_explanation: Neither novelty nor benchmark performance alone decides; both are weighed together.
review_criteria.quote: Rather, it is important to weigh both the novelty and potential impact of the work alongside the reported performance.

review_criteria.name: Fit to CVPR subject areas
review_criteria.official_explanation: Out-of-scope papers must be explained and redirected to a better-matched venue.
review_criteria.quote: If you think the paper is out of scope for CVPR's subject areas, clearly explain why in the review.

review_criteria.name: Rebuttal-time experimental expectations
review_criteria.official_explanation: Reviewers must not demand substantial extra experiments or penalize their absence.
review_criteria.quote: reviewers should not request substantial additional experiments for the rebuttal, or penalize for lack of additional experiments.

review_criteria.name: Dataset contributions must become public
review_criteria.official_explanation: A dataset claimed as a contribution should be publicly available upon publication.
review_criteria.quote: If a paper submission is claiming a dataset as one of its contributions, there should be a reasonable expectation that the dataset will be made publicly available upon publication.

mandatory_policy.statement: Authors must acknowledge that no substantially similar paper is submitted elsewhere during the CVPR 2025 review period.
mandatory_policy.quote: authors acknowledge that no paper substantially similar in content has been or will be submitted to another conference or workshop during the review period (November 14, 2024 – February 26, 2025).

mandatory_policy.statement: Papers are limited to eight pages including figures and tables, plus reference-only pages.
mandatory_policy.quote: Papers are limited to eight pages, including figures and tables, in the CVPR style.

mandatory_policy.statement: Non-anonymized, non-template or over-length papers are rejected without review.
mandatory_policy.quote: Papers that are not properly anonymized, or do not use the template, or have more than eight pages (excluding references) will be rejected without review.

mandatory_policy.statement: Reviewers may not use an LLM to write reviews or meta-reviews at any step.
mandatory_policy.quote: Large language models (LLMs) are NOT allowed to be used for writing the reviews nor the meta-reviews at any step.

mandatory_policy.statement: Authors remain responsible for misrepresentation, factual inaccuracy or plagiarism regardless of tool use.
mandatory_policy.quote: Authors may use any tools they find productive in preparing a paper, but must be aware that they are responsible for any misrepresentation, factual inaccuracy or plagiarism in their paper.

recommended_practice.statement: Code upload as supplementary material is encouraged but not required.
recommended_practice.quote: We encourage (but do not require) authors to upload their code as part of their supplementary material in order to help reviewers assess the quality of the work.

recommended_practice.statement: Authors need not compare against recent arXiv reports but should acknowledge work that directly inspired them.
recommended_practice.quote: Authors are not required to discuss and compare their work with recent arXiv reports, although they should properly acknowledge those that directly and obviously inspired them.

recommended_practice.statement: For CVPR 2025 the only links authorized in supplementary material are Anonymous GitHub links for code.
recommended_practice.quote: No. The only links authorized to appear in the supplementary material are links to Anonymous GitHub, which should only be used to submit code.

compliance_checks.requirement: Submission, supplementary material and links preserve anonymity.
Main paper is at most eight pages excluding references.
The official CVPR 2025 style/template is used.
No substantially similar paper is under review elsewhere during the review period.
Reviews and meta-reviews are not written with an LLM.
